preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 10**5 for N in N_values)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the required permutation N is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == N for N, permutation in zip(N_values, permutations))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the output permutation is equal to the given N.

postconditions.expression: all(set(permutation) == set(range(1, N+1)) for N, permutation in zip(N_values, permutations))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output permutation contains each integer from 1 to N exactly once.

postconditions.expression: all(permutation == '-1' or all(permutation[i] ^ permutation[i+1] != permutation[i+2] for i in range(len(permutation)-2)) for permutation in permutations)
postconditions.description: For each test case, if a permutation is provided, it satisfies the condition that P_i ⊕ P_{i+1} ≠ P_{i+2} for all valid i.
